body:
This Clan is for all you computer geeks!
Anything from HTML to JavaScript.
This clan will be focused on anything relevant to coding/programming. We will be doing small projects here and there. Maybe even a big project!
Please Apply in this format!:

IGN:
Skype:
Your experience in coding/programming?:
If you do not have any experience are you willing to learn various code languages?:
If you have made some sort of website/game with a coding language may you post it here?:
Anything Else?:
No coding experience is needed

HTML and CSS is kindergarten compared to the much more scarier languages. As I might add, HTML is practically useless nowadays and doesn't look nice unless you want your site to look like it's 1996.
